format: Normalized production prompt set; original full prompts also included where retained. The subject and shared/type constraints describe every call.
shared_constraints: Large simple shapes, flat 2–3 tone shading, no texture noise. One clear dominant physical subject; broad modeled material planes; bold one-logical-pixel black contour; upper-left lighting; exact SMS RGB channels 00/55/AA/FF. No isolated pixels, checkerboard, dithering, stipple, antialiasing, glow, text, labels, miniature scenery or scattered debris. Transparent background. Phantasy Star/Ys game item style.

type_constraints.relics: Full-cell 13–14px silhouette, substantial body, max eight opaque colours; native material fit and final 1px outline after recovery.
type_constraints.cards: 32x24 native, one subject approximately 24–26x19px, max ten opaque colours.
type_constraints.graft_palette: Green 005500/00AA00/00FF00, violet 550055/5500AA/AA00FF, root brown AA5500 and gold FFAA00.
type_constraints.chronist_palette: Blue 000055/0055AA/00AAFF, gold AA5500/FFAA00/FFFF00, one pale glint.
type_constraints.colorless_and_afflictions: Grey steel 555555/AAAAAA/FFFFFF, restrained brass and one functional red/cyan/green accent as described.
